items: 【2026 Upgraded Women's Laptop Backpack】-It adopts a rectangular frame opening design and an upgraded new environmentally friendly nylon polyester fabric, which increases durability while also improving its waterproof and stain-resistant performance. It has a total of 5 compartments and 17 pockets, which makes it easy for you to organize and store items.

【Dual Capacity Side Pocket Design】-This college backpack is equipped with 4 side pockets, so you can easily carry water bottles and umbrellas anywhere. One of the external side pockets is designed with an adjustable elastic band, so you can store small-capacity water cups. The other is designed with a nine-shaped buckle, so you can store large-capacity water cups.

【Thickened Computer Backpack and College Schoolbag】-The dedicated 15.6-inch laptop compartment and the iPad slot that can accommodate up to 12.9 inches effectively protect your device. The upgraded cushioning performance surpasses the old model, making it a reliable computer bag for business or campus use.

【Reinforced Frame Breathable Work Backpack】-Its shoulder straps and back are equipped with high-quality upgraded foam pads, which improve comfort and breathability, ensuring all-day comfort. Steel reinforced edges and a structured base are not easily deformed, making it an ideal choice for a sturdy women's backpack that can carry heavy items.

【Anti-theft travel backpack wallet】-The secure luggage strap can be attached to the suitcase, and the hidden back pocket can protect valuables. And it fits perfectly under the airplane seat, allowing you to travel easily no matter where you go. Designed for teachers and travelers who need storage.
